title: Beyond the 956: John Christ, original Danzig guitarist, dies at 61
excerpt: John Christ, the original guitarist of Danzig who played on the band's first four albums, died peacefully November 15, 2026, at 61. His family announced his death on his official social media accounts; no cause of death was disclosed.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

John Christ, the original guitarist of the metal band Danzig who helped shape the group’s early sound on its first four albums, has died at 61.

Christ died peacefully November 15, 2026. His death was announced November 16 on his official social media accounts. “Friends, it is with a heavy heart that we must inform you of the peaceful passing of John Christ on November 15, 2026,” the statement read. “No services are planned and we kindly ask everyone to respect the family’s privacy during this time.” No cause of death was disclosed.

Born John Wolfgang Knoll on February 19, 1965, Christ joined Danzig in the late 1980s and played with the band until 1995. He contributed guitar to all four of the band’s first full-length studio albums — Danzig, Danzig II: Lucifuge, Danzig III: How the Gods Kill and Danzig IV — as well as the Thrall-Demonsweatlive EP. He also performed with Samhain, the band fronted by Danzig singer Glenn Danzig before Danzig formed.

Christ’s guitar work on those early Danzig records helped define the band’s dark, heavy sound during one of the most influential periods of its career, and fellow musicians paid tribute to him after the announcement.

Sources: John Christ’s official social media; Blabbermouth; Knotfest; BraveWords; The PRP.
